profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Software Engineering of America
profile.summary:
I build the systems that move money at the point of sale — and I've worked both sides of the terminal.  

At NCR I wrote point-of-sale software that ran on the checkout lane itself: barcode standards, embedded terminal images, the client application on the register. At Elavon I spent seven years on the other end of that same transaction — a global payment gateway processing 6.2 billion transactions a year across 30+ countries — delivering card-present and EMV flows, integrating physical POS terminals, and building services inside PCI DSS scope.  

That combination is unusual, and it's the through-line of my career. I understand what happens at the terminal and what happens in the cloud services it talks to.  

I'm a hands-on leader. I've managed teams of six and seven engineers while staying in the design and the code every sprint — writing services, reviewing PRs, pairing. I care about the parts of engineering that never show up in a demo: zero-downtime upgrades on a live transaction path, automated test coverage, a CI/CD pipeline people actually trust.  

Today I'm Principal Software Engineer at SEA, leading the cloud-native rebuild of an enterprise mainframe product on GCP, with Macy's as design partner and first customer.  

Mostly working in: Java, Spring Boot, microservices, REST/OpenAPI, Kafka, Redis, Docker, AWS, GCP, Maven, Jenkins, GitLab. Earlier in my career: C#/.NET and C/C++.  

M.S. Computer Science, Georgia Tech · B.S. Computer Science, Clemson (Summa Cum Laude)

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead developer on the cloud-native rebuild of Total Report Management System (TRMS) Distributed, porting an enterprise mainframe product to a containerized microservice architecture on Google Cloud Platform.

• Launched with Macy's as design partner and first customer, delivering the full required feature set against an aggressive timeline in support of their corporate "mainframe zero" initiative.
• Work directly with Macy's DevOps and QA organizations, on-site and remote, translating enterprise requirements into delivered functionality and explaining architectural trade-offs to non-engineering stakeholders.
• Contribute to the product's React and TypeScript Web Admin UI alongside backend and architecture work — delivering bug fixes and new features using Vite, Material UI, and ESLint.
• Automate build and release: Maven and Jenkins pipelines with Docker Hub as artifact registry, GitLab for source control, OpenProject for epic, story, and defect tracking.
positions.insights: Skills: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Microservice architecture · SQL · Jenkins · Ubuntu · JSON · Claude Code · Hibernate · Cloud Computing · Docker · Technical Leadership · Maven · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Gitlab · Windows 11 · IntelliJ IDEA · Spring Boot · Postman · Distributed Systems · JPA · Apache Kafka

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer | Vice President
positions.description:
One of the lead engineers on the Elavon Payment Gateway — a single global omni-commerce platform enabling merchants of every size to accept payments in-store, online, and via mobile across 30+ countries.

• Designed, built, and maintained 100+ Java and Spring Boot microservices forming the core transaction path of a gateway averaging 17 million transactions per day.
• Delivered card-present and EMV transaction flows, including integration with physical POS terminals, connecting in-store checkout hardware through to gateway authorization services.
• Built and maintained services within PCI DSS scope, applying secure handling of cardholder data and supporting the platform's compliance obligations inside a regulated banking organization.
• Delivered zero-downtime upgrades, allowing services on the live transaction path to be released and updated without interrupting merchant payment processing.
• Designed and published the REST/JSON API contracts (Swagger/OpenAPI) consumed by in-store terminal, e-commerce, and mobile clients.
• Managed a team of 7 engineers as a working manager, including annual performance reviews and compensation appraisals, while remaining hands-on in design and code every sprint.
• Drove engineering quality practice — code review, pairing, and Cucumber/BDD automated test coverage — within a full Scrum cadence.
• Automated builds with Maven and Jenkins; deployed containerized services to AWS across Dev, UAT, and Production.

positions.title: Senior Software Architect
positions.description:
• Lead developer, architect, and Scrum Master for Ivory Service Architect, a graphical development environment for building RESTful and SOAP web services over composite IBM mainframe applications — designed and built from the ground up with three other senior engineers.
• Owned the product across the stack in C#/.NET: designed and implemented much of the graphical user interface, plus build validation, server instruction generation, configuration wizards, command-line automation, and profile/options management, using REST, JSON, Swagger, SOAP, XML, XSLT, and HTML.
• Served on the Architecture Committee that set the technology stack for the entire development organization.

positions.title: Distributed Development Manager
positions.description:
• Managed a team of 6 engineers while continuing as a hands-on contributor; owned project scheduling, planning, and monthly status reporting to the CTO.
• Partnered with subsidiary Alchemy Solutions to deliver NeoData 2.0, a mainframe VSAM-to-SQL migration tool — designed a new interface supporting SQL runtime configuration, data editing, and format conversion.
• Promoted to Senior Software Architect in November 2015.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical lead on the R&D team for release 6.0 of Advanced Checkout Solution (ACS), NCR's graphical point-of-sale system for the grocery environment.

• Designed, implemented, and maintained 14-digit UPC (RSS-14) barcode support across the POS application.
• Built unassisted deployment of Windows XP Embedded and Windows 2000 Professional images from the back-office server to client POS workstations, automating rollout across the store estate.
• Developed the client POS application in Visual C++ targeting embedded POS terminal hardware, and back-office server applications in VB.NET on Windows Server.
• Mentored two junior developers and a summer intern through the full development cycle.
positions.insights: Skills: C · Technical Leadership · Point of Sale (POS) Systems · Payment Card Processing · C++

positions.title: Senior Software Consultant
positions.description:
• Scoped, designed, implemented, and maintained features for releases 4.0 and 5.0 of NCR's Advanced Checkout Solution, including customer-specific POS code branches for major grocery retailers.
• Added support for new POS terminal hardware, including modification of application loader scripts to load the correct video and LAN drivers per device.
• Co-designed, developed, and maintained a "frequent shopper" loyalty subsystem sold as an add-on package for ACS.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed an object-oriented DLL for RTF import/export in a graphical word processor across Windows 95, NT, 3.1, and OS/2; implemented the filter in Visual C++, delivered on an aggressive deadline, and maintained both the RTF and Microsoft Word filters.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description: Returned full-time following summer internships in 1991 and 1992. Designed, developed, and tested applets for a GUI point-of-sale application in Visual C++ on Windows; implemented duplicate receipt functionality for ACS and PVCS wrapper commands to streamline version control.
positions.insights: Skills: C · Point of Sale (POS) Systems · C++
